verdict.rationale: Superset exposes a hosted control-plane (api.superset.sh with OAuth-protected MCP server and OpenAPI spec) and markets 'Remote access' as a paid feature, suggesting some cloud-hosted capability, but the product's own docs describe it as local-first ('your code never leaves your machine unless you say so') with a CLI/desktop backend that drives worktrees on a host you provision yourself. This is not evidence of a fully managed cloud service that runs agent compute without the developer operating any backend/host. missing for 10: a documented fully-managed cloud runner/compute tier, evidence that agent execution itself (not just orchestration API) happens on Superset-operated infrastructure, and independent confirmation of a backend-free managed offering.
